title: Signs
starring: Mel Gibson, Joaquin Phoenix, Rory Culkin, Abigail Breslin, Cherry Jones
summary: When mysterious crop circles appear on his Pennsylvania farm, former minister Graham Hess begins to suspect that something extraordinary is happening. As similar phenomena emerge across the world, Graham, his brother and his two children confront the growing possibility of an alien invasion while struggling with fear, faith and their place in the universe.
